purpose: Transport the already-used Stage34 Gaussian degree-two elliptic-quotient interface to three of the four post-#1482 residual sign-orbit representatives. Models 68, 38, and 165 have exact cubic quotient equations over Q(i); model 191 is intentionally excluded because the same invariant gives a quartic genus-one quotient and needs a separate adapter.

prior_proved_interface.meaning: Stage34 has already replayed the same Q(i) involution/invariant, exact rank-one elliptic quotient, odd-index plus elliptic-Chabauty completeness logic, rational reverse reconstruction, and full parent-square test on branch 03f88290bf80ef2e6c98. This is interface precedent only; it grants no credit to the present targets.

generic_exact_adapter.rationality_map: For C(Q), u is rational and every listed alpha is rational, hence quotient X=alpha*u is rational.
generic_exact_adapter.reverse_filter: For finite rational quotient X, set u=X/alpha. A rational parent x exists only if u^2+4 is a rational square; then x=(u+-sqrt(u^2+4))/2. Each candidate is exact-tested on C and against all four U,V,A,B/delta square conditions.
generic_exact_adapter.exceptional_points: x=0 and x=infinity are outside the affine quotient formula and have homogeneous V=0, hence are receiver-degenerate. Rational Weierstrass roots occurring in the selected triple are also receiver-degenerate.

excluded_residual_target.reason: The same invariants give v^2=u*(u-2*i)*(39*u+160)*(40*u+39), a quartic genus-one quotient. Do not force it through the cubic adapter.

magma_adapter.completion_gate: A diagnostic candidate requires PseudoMordellWeilGroup success, elliptic Chabauty completion with the odd-index/IndexBound=2 coprimality condition checked, exact rational reverse reconstruction, and zero nondegenerate full-parent lifts. Separate proof replay and hostile audit are still mandatory.

credit: Diagnostic only. No branch or sign partner closes from this lock or from a bounded/resource-walled run. A successful diagnostic must be frozen into a dedicated exact proof replay and then hostile-audited before authoritative promotion.
